findings.evidence: The brief says the mounted pinned source is sha fc8972cdc16f988a84588ac6f4ce4e3b0abf20b9, while pin.json and every source say 6407052f. The diff moves earlier citations at the same sha: rationales ra2 goes from fm-spawn.sh 3163-3164 to 3325-3330, and AGENTS.md 196 becomes 202. summary: All eight acceptance criteria are met. The three missed behaviours are now claims with checked quotes: teardown reopening an item that is still an open captain call (c23, c24), firstmate merging green work itself when yolo is on (c25, c26), and only a recorded PR or a cleanup freeing a place, with relaunches and secondmates never counted (c30 to c32). They are carried into the model (a new Held open state and transitions t9 and t10), the rationales, the findings and the intro. The study also adds claims beyond the three examples. cargo test, the site build, clippy and fmt all pass when I ran them, but I could not open the rendered page itself; my page check rests on its source data and the passing site tests. The verdict is fail because of one major problem. Athena resolved this job's pinned source to fc8972cd, but every citation is labelled 6407052f. Earlier citations moved to new line numbers in this diff, which shows the mounted tree is not the one first cited as 6407052f. An outside reader checking the page at 6407052f may find lines that do not match. Fixing it means either re-pinning to the mounted commit or mounting 6407052f and re-citing; that choice is outside this job's scope. One minor issue: the page says a recorded PR frees a place at t3, which holds only for PR-based ships.
